title: TermSheet AI Attribute Schema
description: JSON schema for extracting structured clause variables across all 12 canonical venture-capital clause families plus dividends, anchored to verbatim source text spans. Use null for any field not explicitly stated in the document.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote from the document proving these liquidation values.

participation.description: True or participation mode ('non_participating', 'fully_participating', 'capped_participating') indicating participating preferred rights.

cap.description: Participation cap as a multiple of the original purchase price (e.g., 3 means 3x). Null if no cap.

seniority.description: Liquidation seniority tier relative to other preferred stock series.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving the anti-dilution formula.

type.description: Down-round anti-dilution conversion price adjustment mechanism.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving the board composition.

investor_seats.description: Number of board seats designated by preferred investors.

founder_seats.description: Number of board seats designated by founders / common holders.

independent_seats.description: Number of mutually agreed independent board seats.

total_seats.description: Total number of directors on the board.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving the vesting schedule.

vesting_months.description: Total duration of the vesting schedule in months (market standard is 48).

cliff_months.description: The cliff period in months (market standard is 12). Null if no cliff.

acceleration.description: Vesting acceleration upon Change of Control.

vesting_reset.description: True if existing founder shares reset vesting at closing.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving protective provision thresholds and vetoes.

requires_series_majority.description: True if preferred majority approval is required for major corporate actions.

veto_day_to_day_operations.description: True if preferred holders have veto rights over ordinary-course operational decisions.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving information and reporting rights.

has_major_investor_threshold.description: True if financial reporting rights are restricted to Major Investors.

monthly_reporting_required.description: True if monthly financial reporting is mandated.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving right of first refusal and co-sale terms.

investor_co_sale.description: True if investors hold pro-rata co-sale (tag-along) rights on founder transfers.

full_founder_transfer_lockup.description: True if founders are prohibited from transferring shares outright beyond standard ROFR.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving drag-along voting thresholds.

approval_threshold.description: Minimum shareholder voting percentage required to trigger drag-along.

requires_founder_consent.description: True if common/founder majority approval is also required to trigger a sale.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving the employee option pool size.

pool_percentage.description: Option pool reserve as a percentage of post-money capitalization.

pre_money_pool.description: True if the option pool expansion is carved out of pre-money valuation.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving the exclusivity / no-shop duration.

duration_days.description: Duration of the exclusivity/no-shop lockup in calendar days.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving optional and automatic conversion terms.

optional_conversion_ratio.description: Initial optional conversion ratio into Common Stock (standard is 1.0).

automatic_conversion_ipo_threshold.description: Minimum Qualified IPO gross proceeds threshold in millions USD.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving redemption horizon and terms.

redemption_years.description: Years after closing when mandatory redemption becomes exercisable.

interest_rate.description: Annual interest rate on unredeemed shares.

source_span.description: The exact verbatim quote proving dividend terms.

cumulative.description: True if dividends accrue cumulatively regardless of board declaration.
